text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Days 1 to 10, shared half-hours of 2025-07 to 2026-06. Short history is D15 and D18, report only. Dot: estimate. text.tspan: Days 1 to 10, shared half-hours of 2025-07 to 2026-06. Short history is D15 and D18, report only. Dot:
estimate. Line: 95% interval per Primary and 99% interval for pooled rows, from resampling whole months.
Dashed line: same as BG2. Default 1 here is the stack without S below 168 h.
